title: Decode: small-op fusion, SP collectives, drafter tail
shape: NVFP4 1-node D3-32 DP-rank slice (L24 view), r24 (384 verify rows), u132k, k=3, target only (-x); ms per decode step
basis: MEASURED in-step NVFP4 (step_d -q nvfp4 -x, profiled, rhea runs/D-FUSE/step_d/nvB-mx11): family = ATTNRES (fused AttnRes+AG/RS kernels) + SP comm + OTHER (act_quant) + latent RMSNorm + router top-k exposed; achievable = nvfp4_modelopt rows at the same slice (AG 164 + RS 171 + AttnRes 39 us); baseline 0.98 = INFRA NVFP4 decode baseline 18:52 (small 0.47 + SP comm 0.51)
gap_analysis: r24 in-step (nvB-mx11, NVFP4 slice, target only): family exposed 650 us = fused SP boundary kernels 384 + SP comm 15 (model AG+RS+AttnRes 374: 1.07x) + act_quant 136 (18 KDA o_proj inputs on the critical path ~45; 23 SiTU+quant on the side stream) + latent RMSNorm 56 + router top-k 54 (exposure accounting; not critical: the aux-stream latent_down GEMM bounds MegaMoE's start). Measured floors of the D-FUSE-owned part: RS push at our SM push rate (16-B/32-B/bulk forms equal), AG latency-bound (MXFP8 half bytes no faster in the fused kernel), fused AttnRes adds 0.2-1.2 us over the bare collectives. SOL design for the rest (producer-side fusion, not D-FUSE kernels): (1) KDA o_proj MXFP8 input from the KDA core's o_norm epilogue (D-KDA, helper common/mx_rows.store); (2) o-projection GEMM epilogue pushing rows to the SP owners (D-GEMM stream_gemm) -> SpReduceAttnRes push=False: hides ~5 us/layer of serial push; (3) latent RMSNorm in the MegaMoE reduce (D-MOE); (4) SiTU+MXFP8 quant in the shared gate_up epilogue (D-GEMM). With (1)-(3) the family projects to ~0.40-0.45 ms vs achievable 0.374.
inefficiencies: KDA o_proj input act_quant (2.5 us x 18 layers, critical path): belongs in KdaWS's o_norm epilogue (D-KDA; helper common/mx_rows.store ready)
Shared expert SiTU + MXFP8 quant (act_quant<1> 5.5 us x 23, side stream inside the MegaMoE window): into the shared gate_up GEMM epilogue (D-GEMM stream_gemm)
Latent RMSNorm standalone (2.4 us x 23, critical path): into the MegaMoE reduce (D-MOE E2: transfer warps own whole token rows)
Router top-k single_group_topk 4.7 us x 23 (+ MegaMoE _stage 2.7): into the router GEMM epilogue / MegaMoE front (D-GEMM / D-MOE)
SP boundary kernels at ~1.03-1.07x of the model AG+RS+AttnRes (in-step 399 vs 374 us); RS push at ~1.1 TB/s (SM 16-B stores; link peak higher with bulk copies)
Release GQA drafter tail unmeasured: Rhea has only the preview MLA drafter
plan: Measure the SP layer-boundary chain (AttnRes pre/post + AG + RS) at n=4/32/96 on 4 GPUs (bench_kimi_k3_sdec_sp_chain.py)
K1: fuse pre-AttnRes + SP all-gather (cluster AttnRes publishing its output rows by multicast, polling the gathered rows)

K2: fuse SP reduce-scatter owner sum + post-AttnRes (cluster AttnRes reading the TP recv slots as its Lamport delta ring, re-arming slots + gather rows); push from the o-proj epilogue (with D-GEMM) or inside K2
Router GEMM + grouped top-k + MegaMoE prepare as one kernel (coordinate with D-GEMM/D-MOE)
SiTU-and-mul (+MXFP8 quant for NVFP4) into the shared gate_up epilogue (with D-GEMM); latent RMSNorm into the combine / latent_up path
Drafter tail: replace the NCCL final AG by the SP multicast gather; fuse tail kernels
